# wayscloud_regions (Data Source)

Fetches the list of WAYSCloud regions and the services available in each, from `GET /v1/regions`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wayscloud_regions" "all" {}

# Codes of the regions that are currently active
output "active_regions" {
  value = [for r in data.wayscloud_regions.all.regions : r.code if r.available]
}

# Codes of the regions where App Platform can create apps
output "app_regions" {
  value = [for r in data.wayscloud_regions.all.regions : r.code if contains(r.available_services, "apps")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) List of regions, including regions that are not active. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the region is currently available, meaning its `status` is `active`.
- `available_services` (List of String) Services that can currently be created in the region (e.g., `storage`, `databases`, `redis`, `apps`, `kubernetes`, `llm`). Empty unless the region is `active`.
- `city` (String) City where the region is located.
- `code` (String) Region code, lowercase (e.g., `no`, `se`, `dk`). This is the `region` that `wayscloud_app` and `wayscloud_redis_instance` take.
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where the region is located (e.g., `NO`).
- `name` (String) Region display name.
- `status` (String) Region status (e.g., `active`, `maintenance`).
